name: dsh-room-monorepo
description: Two installable DSH sharing modes: dsh-room (whole UI) and @local/dsh-remote-room (one workspace)

scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/dsh-remote-room run build && npm --prefix packages/dsh-room run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/dsh-remote-room run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/dsh-room run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/dsh-remote-room run test && npm --prefix packages/dsh-room run test
